items.title: Claude Fable 5
items.whyItMatters: Anthropic's major release — deeper reasoning, new mythos system for multi-agent behavior, and built-in competitor detection. Worth understanding the safety constraints this time around.

items.title: Show HN: Performative-UI – A react component library of design tropes
items.whyItMatters: A practical React component library that packages common UI patterns (skeleton screens, toast systems, progressive disclosure) into a reusable set. Useful for dashboards and admin panels.

items.title: Apple Core AI Framework
items.whyItMatters: Apple's official Core AI framework docs. If you're building ML features for macOS/iOS apps, this is now the primary integration path replacing older ML approaches.

items.title: Upcoming breaking changes for npm v12
items.whyItMatters: npm v12 breaking changes landed — affects every Node.js project. Review the migration guide early, especially around resolution strategy and workspace hoisting.
